capabilities.name: business-step-order
capabilities.description: Map a LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS business-step name to its step_order (1..6), as stored in m_batch_business_steps and rendered by the business-step configuration API.
capabilities.evidence: Capture jobs-LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS-steps-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the ordered businessSteps list (APPLY_CHARGE_TO_OVERDUE_LOANS=1 ... ADD_PERIODIC_ACCRUAL_ENTRIES=6), corroborated by m-batch-business-steps-readback-raw.json.

seams.name: cob-business-step-order
seams.description: GET the LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS business-step configuration on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_batch_business_steps step_name/step_order list.

note: COB parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). One capability is graded: the business-step order read (cob-business-step-order seam). No money, minor-unit, or rounding surface exists in this context; the only graded integer is the step_order.
